lemmas.primary_translation: put one's foot down; insult or offend

definitions.text: sette ned eller presse foten mot underlaget
definitions.translation: put or press one's foot down against the surface

examples.no: det gjorde vondt å tråkke ned høyrefoten
examples.en: it hurt to put weight on my right foot

examples.no: heller enn å tråkke ned, burde vi støtte hverandre
examples.en: rather than putting each other down, we should support each other
